description.html: PRODUCT DETAILS VIBRANT COLORS. Washable dot markers (60ml each) come in 6 different colors; Green, Blue, Purple, Red, Yellow and Orange. It's really a good art supply for toddlers and kids. Actual Colors May Vary! WASHABLE & NON-LEAK. Dot markers are made of water-based and quick-drying ink that prevents bleeding. Have so much fun with them as they are super easy to wash off with just a little bit of soap. EASY GRIP. The dot markers are nice and chunky and is the perfect marker for small hands with big plans. Its ideal shape andSize makes painting easy and fun for young children and even grownups. HAND-EYE COORDINATION. The dot marker set is great for kids to create their artworks. It can develop kids hand-eye coordination and creativity on color exploration. NON-TOXIC & SAFE. Safety is our priority, thus making our markers washable with non-toxic water-based paint, washable with soap and water and with a quick drying ink to prevent staining or leaking.

PRODUCT DETAILS ON THE GO. Bag measurements when expanded are 17" x 12" x 6.5". Easily carry books, binders, laptops, tablets, phones, cosmetics, keys, travel accessories, clothes, cable. Unisex: Suitable for Men and Women. HEADPHONE JACK. The headphone jack provides a way to listen to music. It can also fit USB charging cable. This travel backpack offers you a more convenient way to charge your phone while walking. MULTI-FUNCTIONAL. Zipper closure. Features 1 large main compartment with double zipper. 1 interior pocket. 1 front compartment. 1 top carrying handle. 2 side mesh pocket fits water bottle or compact umbrella. PADDED BACK PANEL. Soft ventilated padding gives you maximum back support. Breathable and adjustable shoulder straps relieve strain on your shoulders. Light and efficient! DURABLE MATERIAL. Made of 600 D polyester fabric. Ensure secure & long-lasting usage. Great backpacks for college, elementary, middle, high school students, boys, girls, teens. *6 Assorted Color will be shipped for order in Set of 6 *Color will be shipped at random for order in single unit
